item.title: Damaged pavement and sign Heron close junction, 17th July
item.description:
By Heron close junction, damaged sign with tarmac uptruned, another example of how not to fix something, just leave red plastic barriers around it for months on end. the sign is only bent, its not even dangerous. SO many of these barriers spotted around the town, left for months, even years, no accountability to get things fixed. the town looks ugly with all these about.
Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): 202, Hatherley Road, Hatherley, Cheltenham, Cheltenham

item.title: Multiple trees over growing into the roadway obstructing all HGV and agricultural vehicles, 17th July
item.description:
For over six weeks trees and hedgerows on the highway verge between the junction with the A40 and the crossroads for Upper Dowdeswell have overgrown into the road such that any HGV and Agricultural vehicles have to straddle the centre line to progress. Now even small domestic vehicles are obstructed too. There is an increased risk of collision between all motor vehicles, pedestrians and equestrian users on this already hazardous stretch of road.
Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Cotswold
Report on FixMyStreet
